checks.subject: Issuer attribution
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Record provider/document namespace; check schema and byte provenance
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Verify actual issuer-controlled origin or genuine signature/correspondence through independently established authorized channels; letterhead/hash alone insufficient

checks.subject: Original document identity
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Check document ID/reference, original byte length/hash, source variant and pointers
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Privately confirm original issue/reference and relation to requested snapshot; distinguish redacted derivative/reissue

checks.subject: Account ownership
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Check required private reference fields and consistent account/perimeter aliases
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Compare full original private identifiers and ownership/authorized-use evidence; masked number cannot suffice

checks.subject: Exact position references
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Check all 11 requested rows and original reference pointers are present/unique
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Confirm exact original statement/snapshot row-to-instrument relation, not current balance/ticker coincidence

checks.subject: Instrument identifiers
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Compare code/ISIN syntax, namespace/venue/class, duplicates and conflicts
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Verify account-specific stable instrument relation and accepted alternate evidence if ISIN absent; do not infer it

checks.subject: Effective dates
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Check explicit precision, interval order, coverage gaps and honest source/retrieval/knowledge times
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Confirm witnessed applicability and exceptions; no current snapshot or listing/retrieval date substituted for historical continuity

checks.subject: Corporate-action references
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Check action/allocation/entitlement IDs and partition references are present, with pending issues explicit
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Confirm issuer/account stage, ordinary/pending/credit/trading evidence; missing FPT dates remain UNKNOWN

checks.subject: Document integrity
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Recompute original byte hash/size through a future bounded authorized read; check derivative hash separately
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Confirm retained original and custody chain; integrity does not authenticate issuer or financial content

checks.subject: Supersession status
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Check predecessor/version IDs and simultaneous conflicting sources
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Confirm actual issuer revision/correction scope; no latest-wins or overwrite of old evidence

checks.subject: Revocation status
checks.futureAutomatedChecks: Check required current decision/source revocation references and fail on unknown head
checks.authenticatedHumanOrAuthorityReview: Authorized reviewer checks genuine source/decision/key/role validity under separately approved trust infrastructure
